models_evaluated: machine learning-based postembolization syndrome risk prediction clinical decision support system

links.outcome: Nurse caring attitude, pain barrier identification, comfort care competence; patient symptom interference with vs without CDSS
links.effect: Experimental group showed statistically significant improvements in patient-centered caring attitude, pain management barrier identification, and comfort care competence; patient symptom interference significantly decreased versus before the intervention.
links.quote: Notably, the experimental group exhibited statistically significant improvements in patient-centered caring attitude, pain management barrier identification, and comfort care competence after clinical decision support system implementation.

screen.reason: This randomized controlled trial evaluates the clinical impact of deploying a machine learning-based clinical decision support system versus standard materials (handbook only) on nursing practices and patient outcomes, rather than testing a specific AI deployment guardrail/practice.
